title: Morty Finds A Broken Rick In Part 3

series.summary: Morty escapes the woods and tracks Rick to MIT, only to discover Rick locked away his multiverse research and gave up science for Alcoholics Anonymous.

cuts.voiceover_text: Morty laced up the dead boy's sneakers, knowing his only way home was finding a version of his grandfather who could build a portal gun. Slipping through the dark underbrush, he froze as blinding headlights suddenly swept across the trees. The alien search truck crept along the dirt road. Holding his breath, Morty ducked beneath the shadows and sprinted out of the woods toward freedom.

After tracking Rick to his university office, Morty begged him for help. But Rick pointed to a dusty box of multiverse research and refused. Interdimensional travel had almost destroyed his life, and he would never touch it again.

Hoping to change his mind, Morty followed Rick across campus to a crowded hall. But instead of returning to his lab, Rick stepped up to the podium and made a shocking confession to the room. He was an alcoholic.
